title: Winey Silky Canadian Salmon Pilaf
description: A nostalgic Canadian dish featuring salmon, this pilaf is cooked in a flavorful wine broth and finished with a silky deglaze fond.
instructions: Season the salmon fillets with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Heat the butter in a large oven safe skillet over medium high heat.
Sear the salmon fillets for 2 minutes on each side.
Remove the salmon from the skillet and set aside.
Add the flour to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Stir in the uncooked rice and return the salmon to the skillet.
Cover the skillet with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the rice is tender and the salmon is cooked through.
